exercises.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Me have just sent the email.
I WRONG just sent the email.
I have just sent the email.
exercises.answer: I have just sent the email.
exercises.explanation: Correct pattern for Just, Already & Yet: Just = very recent | Already = before expected | Yet = until now (?/−)
